evals.prompt: Run /theme-forge init in the current project for a bilingual English and Arabic furniture storefront called Cedar & Loom. Use the slug cedar-loom, support English and Arabic with RTL for Arabic, and create the design-first prototype structure and documentation without adding Shopify Liquid or homepage sections.
evals.expected_output: A preserved or newly created design-first workspace with the default page prototypes represented, docs/theme-settings.md containing the identity and global settings contract, docs/shopify-wiring.md as a not-started placeholder, and AGENTS.md with a CLAUDE.md symbolic link. The report identifies created, updated, skipped, and unresolved items.

evals.prompt: Run /theme-forge wire against this existing Shopify prototype. Inspect the design/ and docs/ directories plus any Liquid, JSON, CSS, JavaScript, fixture, and app-integration files you find. Produce or update docs/shopify-wiring.md only; do not modify the prototype or Shopify production files. Clearly mark inferred and unresolved mappings.
evals.expected_output: A codebase-specific docs/shopify-wiring.md with all required mapping sections, observed/inferred/proposed confidence, classification labels, Shopify data paths, accessibility/localization risks, and a created/updated/skipped/unresolved completion report.

evals.prompt: I want to use Theme Forge for a Shopify theme, but I have not said whether to initialize a prototype or audit an existing one. What should I do next? Do not inspect or change files yet.
evals.expected_output: A concise explanation of /theme-forge init and /theme-forge wire, followed by a question asking the user to choose one. No files are created or modified.
